title: Distributional Adaptive Regression Estimator under Series Expansion
text: Least squares regression can inefficient error distribution far Gaussian, example heavy tails outliers. distributionally adaptive regression estimator (DARE) Dai (2025) estimates conditional mean E[Y∣X=x0]E[Y \mid X = x_0] weighted combination conditional quantiles levels k/(K+1)k/(K+1), k=1,…,Kk = 1, \dots, K. weights adapt unknown error distribution, number quantiles KK chosen cross-validation. regularity conditions DARE attains asymptotic variance infeasible likelihood-based estimator keeping convergence rate conventional estimators. DARESR implements series (B-spline) version DARE. covariate expanded B-spline basis, conditional quantiles fitted quantile regression (quantreg), quantiles combined weights inverse estimated asymptotic covariance matrix. estimate comes standard error 95% confidence interval. Documentation: https://shengtao-dai.github.io/DARESR/

title: Distributional Adaptive Regression Estimator under Series Expansion
code: library(DARESR)  # Simulated data with heavy-tailed (t, 3 df) errors; the true m(0, 0) is 0.5 set.seed(123) n <- 500 X <- cbind(rnorm(n), rnorm(n)) Y <- as.numeric(0.5 + X %*% c(1, -1) + rt(n, df = 3))  res <- series_eq_estimate(Y, X, x0 = c(0, 0), p = 4, degree = 4,                           K_grid = c(1, 3), L = 2) unlist(res) #>       m_hat_series_eq     cov_hat_series_eq m_hat_series_eq_lower #>            0.35851451            0.14271055            0.07880183 #> m_hat_series_eq_upper #>            0.63822719

title: Distributionally adaptive regression estimator (series expansion) — series_eq_estimate
text: Estimates conditional mean \(m(x_0) = E[Y \mid X = x_0]\) weighted combination series quantile regression estimates levels \(\tau_k = k / (K + 1)\), \(k = 1, \dots, K\). covariate expanded B-spline basis, conditional quantiles fitted quantreg::rq(), weights come inverse estimated asymptotic covariance matrix K quantile estimates. K chosen K_grid L-fold cross-validation.

title: Distributionally adaptive regression estimator (series expansion) — series_eq_estimate
code: series_eq_estimate(Y, X, x0, p, degree, c_band = 1, K_grid, L = 5)

title: Distributionally adaptive regression estimator (series expansion) — series_eq_estimate
text: Y Numeric response vector length n. X Numeric matrix data frame covariates (n x d). x0 Numeric vector length d, target point. p Integer, number equally spaced knot intervals per covariate (p - 1 interior knots). degree Integer, degree B-spline basis. c_band Numeric scalar, bandwidth constant. K_grid Integer vector candidate numbers quantiles K. L Integer, number cross-validation folds.

title: Distributionally adaptive regression estimator (series expansion) — series_eq_estimate
text: list m_hat_series_eq: estimate \(m(x_0)\); cov_hat_series_eq: estimated standard error; m_hat_series_eq_lower, m_hat_series_eq_upper: 95% confidence interval, m_hat_series_eq -/+ 1.96 * cov_hat_series_eq.

title: Distributionally adaptive regression estimator (series expansion) — series_eq_estimate
text: bandwidth used covariance estimate \(h = c_{band} \, n^{-1/5}\). Cross-validation folds drawn set.seed(1), results reproducible, global random number generator reset.
